audit_tiers.A: root-import coverage + exact canonical Lean module build + exact hash stability + produced .olean + policy scan + relevant Python tests + documentation schema + baseline freeze; independent external rerun not required
audit_tiers.B: tier A + targeted declaration/axiom audit of nontrivial theorems + one substantive cross-layer/adversarial probe
audit_tiers.C: tier B + external full audit for critical theorem/obstruction paths

rule: New freezes and re-freezes must pass v6: exact canonical Lean module build, source-hash stability, produced .olean, root-import coverage, policy scan, relevant Python evidence, documentation schema, and the tier-specific proof requirements. Historical v5 freezes remain explicitly versioned and accepted for dependency closure until independently revalidated.
tier_rule: AUDIT_TIERS.tsv is the planned minimum tier. A node may escalate to a higher tier when implementation reveals greater mathematical risk; freezing below the planned tier is forbidden.
build_coverage_rule: For v6, the canonical module from CANONICAL_CROSS_LAYER_MAP_V12.tsv must be directly imported by src/CNNA.lean. Per-node validation actively runs `lake build +<lean_module>`, verifies the source hash before/after, requires the module .olean, and for Tier B/C resolves every named proof-audit declaration through `#print axioms` in an importing Lean environment. `validate_lean_build_coverage.py --all-frozen` applies the same active per-node module/.olean/axiom check to every currently FROZEN_VERIFIED node without rewriting its historical frozen_under_gate_version.
